messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: release/2026-03-17 model-variant=v2.1-eu rollout=20% region=eu-west-1 commit=8f3a2b
deploy-bot: postdeploy smoke: health-checks=OK, synthetic-embed-probe=queued
maria nguyen: seeing embed synth failures in post-deploy checks, alerts from synth-runner. ~3% 502s from embed-service and some 2-3s latencies
kevin cho: can you paste a log snippet?
maria nguyen: here —
```
[synth-runner] 2026-03-17T14:02:06Z embed request failed: 502 downstream embed-service shard-3
payload_len=512 model=v2.1-eu latency=3500ms concurrent=12
```
sam riley: v2.1 touched attention kernel selection + default max_seq=2048 right? could be memory/regression on grouped-attn path
maria nguyen: right — v2.1 bumped max_sequence and enabled grouped attention fallback on GPU. suspect memory pressure on embed-service shard-3 under concurrent synth probes
jordan li: did deploy traffic itself spike? rollout is 20% but synth runners fire every 30s per node, might amplify load
ops-bot: Observed OOM restarts on embed-service-pool-3 around 14:01:30 UTC, controller restarted 2 pods. Metrics dashboard: <https://dash.internal/embed-service/pool-3/errors>
kevin cho: recommend immediate mitigation: pin routing for eu region back to model=v2.0 and pause the rest of the rollout. low-risk rollback path
maria nguyen: agreed. mitigation plan: 1) apply routing pin -> v2.0 in eu-west-1 2) scale embed-service pool + bump readiness/read timeout 3) reduce synth frequency temporarily
deploy-bot: Routing pin applied: eu-west-1 -> model=v2.0 (applied by deploy-bot at 14:05:12 UTC)
sam riley: i'll lower synth-runner frequency for eu to 5m to stop amplification (doing now)
maria nguyen: synth cron disabled for eu, will re-enable after stability confirmed
kevin cho: I'll open a quick issue with investigation checklist: kv-cache pressure, kernel fallback traces, mem growth, commit diff for v2.1 (quant/attn changes)
jordan li: can someone draft a short note for #releases so customers/internal stakeholders know we pinned and are investigating? Not a full rollback but an emergency pin
maria nguyen: on it, drafting note to post after embed-service stabilizes
ops-bot: embed-service error rate trending down after pin; current 10m error rate = 0.3% (baseline 0.2%) continuing to monitor
maria nguyen: current synth failure rate down to ~0.2% over last 10m window, looks much better :thumbsup:
kevin cho: follow-ups: add a guard to synth-runner that soft-limits per-region concurrency, and add memory pressure alert on grouped-attn kernel Fallbacks
jordan li: cc @oncall for overnight watch and to pick up any further regressions
maria nguyen: thanks everyone. tagging as incident:minor and will attach logs/graphs in the follow-up issue.
